content.weeklyOverview: Preschoolers investigate how farm animals move, communicate, live, and help people. The week progresses from meeting and comparing animals, to building habitats and caring for them, to exploring farm jobs and foods, and finally to designing and sharing a collaborative class farm. Children learn through sensory play, construction, dramatic play, music, movement, books, conversation, counting, and open-ended art.
